fieldData.awb---integration-feature-2:
Signups that arrive already tagged by type

Renata Voss gives readers a reason to subscribe: a 12-question enneagram quiz linked from her Tuesday newsletter. In May, 530 people finish it and 221 leave an email for the full result. Each address lands in her list tagged with its type, so the welcome email can speak to it.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { coachingIntake: "Build an enneagram intake quiz for my coaching practice. I want 27 scenario questions, each option mapped to one of the nine types, and a short result page per type. When a client finishes, email me the type lean and save every answer to my client table so I can read it before our first session.", teamOffsite: "Build an enneagram quiz for the 21 consultants at my firm before our June offsite. Give me a dashboard that shows how many answers are in, the split by center, and who has not finished, and schedule reminder emails for the last week before the date.", leadMagnet: "Build a 12-question enneagram quiz I can link from my Tuesday newsletter. Show a short result to everyone, and offer the full write-up in exchange for an email address. Tag each address with the type it landed on, and sync the tagged list to my mailing tool.", smallGroupNight: "Build an enneagram quiz for my church's small group night. Everyone answers the same questions on their phones, and a rule assigns each finished quiz to a room by center: Body to Room 1, Heart to Room 2, Head to Room 3. Print a room list when the sorting is done." };

acrm---key-feature-3-image.alt: Renata Voss's newsletter quiz asks for an email before the full result; May shows 530 finished quizzes and 221 new subscribers, each tagged by type.
